disposition_reason: Review of As/Cd/Pb in food. Cocoa content is secondary: Table 1 pools 'Coffee & tea & cocoa' (Cd national means 0.0001-1.8 mg/kg, n=3505; Pb ND-1.03 mg/kg, n=764), not separable for cocoa; text restates Zug et al. 2019 (cocoa Cd 1.8 mg/kg without vs 3.5 mg/kg with fertilizer) and the EU Cd ML of 0.3 mg/kg for chocolate with >=30% and <50% total dry cocoa solids.
disposition_locator: Table 1 (p.3); 'Cadmium in Food' paragraph citing refs 48-54

controls.control: Fertilizer application (secondary citation of Zug et al. 2019, Peru)
controls.outcome: cocoa Cd 1.8 mg/kg without fertilization -> 3.5 mg/kg with fertilizers (as restated; product/tissue and basis not specified)

regulatory.product: chocolate with >=30% and <50% of total dry cocoa solids

contradictions_with_stored_summary: Stored summary lists 'Cocoa, tea, coffee 0.0001-1.8 mg/kg' as if cocoa data; primary category is pooled coffee & tea & cocoa national means.
unresolved: Zug et al. 2019 values should be taken from the primary (in corpus check separately); review does not specify tissue or basis.
Pooled coffee/tea/cocoa ranges cannot be attributed to cocoa.
